ignoreValues.reason: Claude: dynamic src from AdventureCard.cover, rendered only when repo.ts coverOf() found a site-path or https src

Claude: false positive, measured 2026-09-23. The 'covered' text is inside collapsed <details class=bd-event__details> (checkVisibility() false); Chromium keeps layout boxes for closed details content, under the next event. Opened, nothing overlaps. Kept findable by Ctrl+F, so not display:none. See detector-waivers.md.

Claude: two-column section head at >=1280px; each h2 binds to the block BESIDE it (its placeholder), and the 159px below is the gap to the next section, which a vertical measure reads as crowding. Sections are placeholders until the couple chooses a registry (TODO). See detector-waivers.md.

Claude: approved REF-WEEKEND three-column workspace, whose side column went one-up in PX-24; the short RSVP column is sticky under the masthead at >=1280px (guest.css) so it never floats over empty paper. Rebalancing the columns is the couple's call. See detector-waivers.md.

waivers.cream-palette: docs/design/brief.md §4 pins the grounds: Gilded Hour is white Carrara marble (#F8F6F1), Conservatory is creme herbarium paper (#F4EEDF). The brief wins over the saturated-pattern warning (impeccable SKILL.md: 'The brief wins').
waivers.src/themes/*/fonts.css: Metric-matched fallback faces ('Cinzel Fallback' etc.) are @font-face names for local() fallbacks, not DESIGN.md families; stylelint still bans the anti-reference fonts there.
waivers.playwright-report/**: Generated Playwright HTML report (gitignored). Its inlined Ubuntu/Droid Sans Mono/Helvetica and grey literals are the reporter's own chrome, not this site's design system.
waivers.kicker-above-heading: The approved Botanical–Deco pages (Sara and Tyler's sign-off) set a short tracked label above each title; kept only where the approved images have one. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.all-caps-body: The approved Botanical–Deco date, place and page subtitles are single tracked-caps lines at the 17px control-caps step, never paragraphs. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.italic-serif-display: The approved Explore page sets 'Chicago' as one italic Bodoni display word (REF-EXPLORE); it is the only italic display on the site. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.hero-eyebrow-chip: REF-EXPLORE sets 'SARA + TYLER' in tracked capitals above the page title; the companion page heads keep that one line and nothing else above their H1. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.clipped-overflow-container: Our Story's ride stage (.bd-ride__stage, .bd-ride__window) shows one moment at a time: the moment being left drifts out sideways as the next drifts in, and the window clips them at its edge. The line diagram above it is a horizontal scroller that keeps the train centred. No other surface clips a positioned child. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.cramped-padding: The ride's car card (the CTA line diagram) runs edge to edge across the top of the stage by design, like the strip map above a train's doors; the moments under it carry their own inset. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.stages/*/out/**: Static exports of the pipeline stages, and public/_stages/ which assembles them into the wedding app (gitignored build output). Their sources are scanned; stage 4's export inlines each design's own DESIGN.md colours, which are judged in src/themes/, not against the root scale.
waivers.stages/04-placeholder/app/themes/**: Copies of src/themes/<id>/theme.css + fonts.css made by stages/04-placeholder/scripts/sync-themes.mjs (gitignored). The originals are scanned in src/themes/.
